title: Violet Ultragiant Star
description: Replacing our sun with an Ultragiant violet star!!!
body:
**What if we replace our sun with a bigger one, like ultragiant stars??!!!!!** 

Well this pack will make that change, the Ultragiant star is known as the largest and the rarest type of star in the universe it is also superior to hypergiant in terms of radius,  But because of its size and mass, this star becomes unstable and approaches its death. 

## Installation
- Download the file
- Place the file in resourcepack file inside _.minecraft_
- Turn on the pack by moving it to right column _in game_
- Finally you made it!
